m9_compatibility: M9 v1 public API, policy, objective, result identity and search implementation are unchanged; ResourceV1Boundary dispatches to M9 without interpreting its transitions.

battle_transition.legal_view: ReferenceBattleSession.legal_actions; complete only for caller-declared local envelopes
battle_transition.next_actor: M10 ordinary reference scheduler after local SUCCESS

policy.node_limit: positive integer; root is one explored node; a committed successor beyond the limit is not evaluated
policy.max_plans: positive integer; output truncation only after ranking, never changes exploration
policy.tie_policy: LOCAL_PLANNER_POLICY; lexicographic path of declared envelope ordinals

objective.entity_identity: An exact entity_id is required for every entity field objective.
objective.satisfaction: Horizon objectives evaluate only at exact depth; reach objectives evaluate root and every committed successor and stop a branch at first satisfaction. Objective satisfaction does not assert game terminal.

state_accounting.key: transition scope + session spec identity + objective identity + policy identity + remaining horizon + M10 semantic hash
state_accounting.collision_check: Full M10 snapshot equality is required after a hash match.
state_accounting.blocked_states: Explored nodes with a blocked complete local legal-action view; no partial action list is treated as complete.
state_accounting.rejected_edges: Failed action attempts never become explored nodes.

result.found_incomplete: BEST_OBSERVED under the local caller objective, never native or global optimality
result.step_records: Exact M10 ReferenceBattleStep/1 documents; no conversion to M8 TrajectoryStep
result.identity: Domain-separated SHA-256 over canonical-v2 documents excluding only their own ID; no wall-clock time or machine path
result.replay: Reconstruct M10 initial spec, legal action source ordinals, complete M10 steps and objective; also rerun the whole search for result validation.

training_boundary: Search demonstrations and caller objective values do not imply native labels, rewards, values, Q targets or policy probabilities.
next_phase: M12 content binding may replace synthetic local envelopes only where existing exact 4.4.54 evidence permits.
